title: UHF RFID Wristbands
description: UHF RFID wristbands with longer read range for event check-in, participant tracking, access control and hands-free identification workflows.
summary: UHF RFID wristbands designed for longer read-range identification, making them suitable for participant tracking, event operations and hands-free access workflows.
The ProudTek UHF wristband is made from silicone material and features a special crafting process, giving it a comfortable, skin-like feel.
Our UHF wristband can read about 4 meters on wearing on wrist.

faq.question: What are UHF RFID Wristbands commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for longer-range attendee, visitor, or staff identification when HF and NFC wristbands do not provide enough read distance.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for UHF RFID Wristbands?
faq.answer: Chip: Monza R6 Protocol: ISO18000-6C Frequency: 860-960mhz,

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for UHF RFID Wristbands?
faq.answer: Material: Silicone Form Factor: Wearable wristband form factor for access control or event use. Dimensions: 150mm,180mm,195mm,210mm, etc. Color: Black or customized.

faq.question: How can UHF RFID Wristbands be customized?
faq.answer: Printing: silkscreen printing, laser engraving+pigment filling
